title: Composed campaigns: each control on a composed path is load-bearing
note: Section 7. Each mutation disables one control a K-campaign crosses, in a module other than the one the campaign is about, and the campaign must notice. tests/test_composed_campaigns.py holds each.

mutations.name: KC1_an_interval_never_lapses
mutations.rationale: K1: an outdated reading stays FRESH, and a current-world claim rests on it

mutations.name: KC2_a_conclusion_ignores_lapsed_evidence
mutations.find:
lapsed = [o for o in self._recs[basis[0]].basis
                      if not self._usable(o, at)]
mutations.rationale: K1: a conclusion is recorded on a verdict whose evidence ran out

mutations.name: KC3_an_observation_from_no_standing_record
mutations.rationale: K2: a remembered note is offered as an observation; without this gate nothing refuses it as research evidence (the test then fails on the missing record rather than a refusal)

mutations.name: KC4_the_gateway_ignores_a_policy_change
mutations.rationale: K3: a model is called with a context built under a superseded policy

mutations.name: KC5_the_store_accepts_a_superseded_digest
mutations.rationale: K3: a decision taken under the superseded version replays as if taken under the one in force

mutations.name: KC6_the_second_reader_accepts_a_superseded_digest
mutations.rationale: K3: the independent reader no longer notices which version a decision cites

mutations.name: KC7_the_witness_comparison_misses_a_fork
mutations.rationale: K4: a rewritten history verifies against a cosignature of the original head
